label: The v4.0.1.0 release notes are a 196-line document titled 'Every Skill Routes From Its Own File'; its Spec folders line names nine packets and is the authoritative closure list for that release.

v4.0.1.0 moved routing tables from each SKILL.md into a sibling ROUTER.md, cutting the loaded corpus across 54 skills and modes from 328333 to 238406 tokens; a skill keeping its router inside SKILL.md now fails package_skill.py --strict.

v4.0.1.0 introduced the doctor command family, decision capture on five runtimes, multi-turn conversation playbooks and the sk-code-frontend web surface with a starter tokens.css; a README dating the doctor commands to v4.0.2.0 is one release late.
v4.0.1.0 retires four surfaces, all breaking: mcp-magicpath, sk-vision with /vision, sk-design-fundamentals, and the LLM Gateway GPT-6 Luna and Sol routes; sk-design keeps exactly three modes.

v4.0.1.0 is where OpenCode-only files moved into a singular .opencode folder (plugins in .opencode/plugins, goal command in .opencode/commands/goal-opencode.md) and where .skilled/release stopped shipping.
v4.0.1.0 records that v4.0.0.17 was withdrawn and that v4.0.1.0 replaces it, so a README version history must not list v4.0.0.17 as shipped.

The 253-line v4.0.2.0 notes title the release 'Skilled in Your Own Project' and add the root INSTALL-SKILLED.md plus system-skilled-doctor, which owns ten setup commands and adds /doctor:overlay with status, apply, repin and --rollback.

v4.0.2.0 adds host-index discovery via .speckit-index and .skilled-host.json indexDir, history lookup after compaction, and DeepSeek Harness as an experimental CLI, and removes Hermes Agent along with .hermes, cli-hermes and the hermes shell function.

v4.0.0.0..v4.0.1.0 is 142262 files with 6451293 insertions and 16124638 deletions, but the mass is deleted historical spec trees (specs/cli-orca 28860 files and 5757589 deletions against 49 insertions; specs/sk-communication 8612 files and 2894517 deletions with zero insertions), so file counts must not measure user-visible change.

Added implementation-summary.md path counts overstate packet closures because v4.0.2.1 regrouped the ten largest tracks into named sub-tracks at specs/track/sub-track/NNN-slug, making moved packets count as additions; the trustworthy closure lists are the changelog Spec folders lines with 9, 10 and about 25 named packets.

Runtime coverage is per feature, not uniform: decision capture names five runtimes at v4.0.1.0, history lookup names six at v4.0.2.0 with Cursor unsupported, and env-secret-guard names all eight at v4.0.2.1, so a README matrix must say up to eight and qualify each row.
